description: A reasoning lens for product and marketing decisions by conviction and reduction — what to build, what to cut, what the product means to the customer rather than its spec sheet, naming, launch framing and the end-to-end experience. Use when you say "product-visionary", "what should we cut", "is this focused", "how do we launch / position / name this", "is our marketing about values or specs", or want a blunt product critique. An abstract archetype, not modelled on or endorsed by any real person.
